storage.retention_policy: Preserve in place; do not delete or overwrite as part of release validation.

raw_video_directory.hash_coverage: Accepted source hashes are recorded per record in manifests/video_source_inventory.csv; the directory also contains non-release candidates.

processed_media_directory.hash_coverage: The 1263 formal scene clip hashes and byte sizes are recorded in manifests/scene_manifest.csv.

keyframe_directory.hash_coverage: Relative keyframe paths are recorded in manifests/video_evidence_manifest.csv; per-keyframe SHA-256 was not frozen in v1.

limitations: The SSH alias resolves only on an authorized maintainer workstation.
Raw and processed media are not part of the Git release.
Per-keyframe hashes were not frozen in v1; keyframes are not required for metric replay.
